newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U shares rise on new launches.
newsitem.headline: P&U shares rise on new launches.

text.p: Shares in U.S./Swedish drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn (P&U) rose on Wednesday after the company posted its 1996 earnings and said its focus in 1997 would be on new products.
At 1300 GMT P&U shares were six crowns higher at 288 crowns. Ahead of the report at 1050 GMT, P&U shares were four crowns lower than Tuesday's close at 282 crowns.
"I think people were a bit nervous ahead of the report but the figures have come in as expected," one broker said.
"But the share price has gone up as people have seen that P&U intends to have new launches and that has created a bit more optimism."
P&U on Wednesday posted a 6.1 percent rise in earnings per share for 1996 to $1.90, against market expectations of $1.92, on net earnings of $998 million before non-recurring items.
The company said its focus in 1997 would be on new products and some medicines will be launched sooner than planned.
